scope: Steady camera after terrain settles, except the moving drive scene; p50/p95 in ms. render = main-thread render callback; submit = time inside backend submits; gpuMs = timer query around the render callback's GL commands; renderFinishMs = render + gl.finish() in a separate window (skipped with --allocations). Rabbits wander and traffic varies, so populated scenes are not exact replays. The spike (56 lines, not committed) drew the first-person scene with the fixed view's x, y − z projection, cards facing south, no fog, the player's own body shown and collection culled to the fixed camera's rectangle; the 3D scene draws flat-coloured ground and no grass, particles or decals. One run per cell.
